text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown invited me to a hotel 
restaurant today, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To be exact, it's a "tasting session for 
the new menu"! This restaurant belongs to 
an acquaintance of my dad's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"My dad usually comes, but whenever he 
can't make it, I step in for him!"

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Chef
text_block_list.text:
Lady Crown! Thank you for coming all this 
way. We look forward to your frank 
opinions once again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even so... that's quite a lot again this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wide variety of dishes were crammed onto 
the table. Even for an Umamusume, this 
amount seemed excessive.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still, since this is for a restaurant, 
we'll need to consider the portion sizes 
as well..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao! Let's eat it all up and give them our 
frank thoughts!
choice_data_list:
Let's take it one bite at a time to keep 
the portions down.

Let's finish it all and live up to their 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, as far as I was concerned, I thought 
eating it all would be well within 
reason...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, then there must be some 
sort of concern.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer. Let us eat it bite by 
bite this time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still... because of that, having one more 
person's opinion would really help! Could 
I ask you for yours?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them went around 
taste-testing, and were thanked for giving 
their candid opinions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's right. That's what we came 
here for!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This chicken steak is amazing! The 
broccoli cream sauce is so rich...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Even with that paella earlier, the savory 
seafood flavor spread with just one bite—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, calling it quite a lot... Everything 
is so delicious, I'll clear my plate in no 
time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono Crown finished every single 
dish and shared her impressions.
